providers.name: kimi
providers.notes: OpenAI-compat; json_schema Structured Output now officially documented (2026-07-30, 'recommended') — the json_object_only param_policy stays in the known set (genui_bridge uses it) but is no longer mandatory for Kimi. Fixed temperature/top_p — omit them or it errors (A). Anthropic-compat /anthropic exists (B).

providers.name: zai
providers.notes: OpenAI-compat (api.z.ai/api/paas/v4) is the safe PAYG default. The Anthropic-compat endpoint (api.z.ai/api/anthropic) bills PAYG balance only if the account has never purchased a Coding Plan; once any plan was purchased (even expired) the route needs manual allowlisting — second-class. Engine use needs PAYG keys, not a Coding-Plan subscription.

providers.name: anthropic
providers.notes: Messages API native (base_url is unversioned; the gateway appends /v1/messages). An official OpenAI-compat layer now exists at https://api.anthropic.com/v1 (testing-oriented: response_format ignored, no prompt caching, temperature capped at 1) — a real fallback, not the primary route.

providers.name: openai
providers.notes: Responses-primary, chat/completions live; 5.x reasoning rejects explicit temperature — omit.

providers.name: deepseek
providers.notes: OpenAI-format native + first-party /anthropic; thinking default ON, sampling silently ignored; reasoning_content must echo in tool loops or 400 (A).

providers.name: fugu
providers.notes: Optional frontier entry. Pricing now official (2026-07-30): Fugu Ultra $5/$30 per 1M ($10/$45 above 272k ctx, cached $0.50); Fugu Cyber $6/$36; base Fugu billed at the underlying model's rate. OpenAI-compatible API live for all three models; per-request cost reporting; not available in EU/EEA. base_url stays null until an endpoint + key exist; pool opt-outs map to catalog config.
